project.name: KnewSearch AEO Visibility Platform
project.mission: Measure and improve brand visibility in AI generated search answers by monitoring prompts, generating answers via Gemini, extracting citations and brand mentions, storing results in BigQuery, scoring visibility, detecting change over time, and producing dashboards and weekly summaries.
mvp_scope: Prompt library seeded from config plus CRUD API
Daily scheduled runs using Cloud Scheduler plus Pub Sub
Gemini answer generation with retries and rate limiting
Parsing for urls, domains, brand mentions, named entities
Embeddings using Vertex AI and vector storage in BigQuery
Minimal Next.js dashboard with read only views
Weekly summary generation using Gemini written to BigQuery and email ready text
non_goals: No multi tenant enterprise RBAC beyond basic auth
No automatic content publishing in MVP

backend.style: small services, async jobs, structured json logs

frontend.scope: minimal dashboard, read only, simple charts

data_model.partitioning: Partition ai_answers, citations, visibility_scores, weekly_summaries by event_date
data_model.clustering: Cluster by brand, prompt_id, domain where appropriate

service_contracts.job_flow: Cloud Scheduler triggers prompt_runner daily. prompt_runner publishes prompt batch messages to Pub Sub. answer_generator consumes, calls Gemini, stores raw answers. parser consumes answer events, extracts citations and mentions. scoring runs aggregation queries into visibility_scores. weekly_summary runs weekly and writes executive summary text.

python: structured logging json with request_id and run_id
retry with exponential backoff for external calls
api: auth via simple API key for MVP

acceptance_criteria: Daily run completes with stored answers, citations, and scores
Dashboard shows brand trend and top citations
Weekly summary is generated and stored
End to end smoke test script passes from fresh project
